value.rationale: A complete arithmetic classification of the entire exceptional family in the smallest possible dimension for noncentrally symmetric maximal-vertex simplicial binary polytopes. The natural lattice h*-invariant distinguishes three numerically different Ehrhart profiles inside the single common ordinary face type, and two small dilations suffice to distinguish four affine classes (with V2/V3 identical), making the table usable in future classification and arithmetic-comparison questions. The normalized lattice volume spectrum is complete; this is not an arbitrary slice, recoding, or known table restatement.
